headline: GIFT Nifty signals positive start for Indian markets despite mixed Asian global cues

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty jumped 200 points signaling a positive start for Indian benchmarks.
Global tech rout caused Kospi to drop 5% and Nikkei to fall 2.5% on AI trade concerns.
Banking and metal stocks saw heavy profit-taking in recent sessions.
Pre-market consolidation in gold and the dollar continues ahead of US inflation data.
whatHappening: GIFT Nifty trades higher suggesting initial gains for Sensex and Nifty 50.
Goldman Sachs and Societe Generale purchased a ₹920 crore stake in Lenskart.
Tata Motors PV, Hyundai Motor, Lenskart, and Gland Pharma are featured as stocks to watch.
Indian markets open following volatility earlier in the week where Sensex shed over 1,400 points.
summary: GIFT Nifty signals a positive opening for Indian equities despite tech-led sell-offs in Asian markets like Kospi and Nikkei. Shares of Tata Motors PV, Hyundai Motor, Gland Pharma, and Lenskart are in focus today. Goldman Sachs and SocGen bought a combined ₹920 crore stake in Lenskart.
